page.overview:
What is Fourth Alsakan Conflict?

The Fourth Alsakan Conflict was a war between Coruscant and Alsakan that was part of a large series of events that began in 17,000 BBY. Two notable battles during the conflict were the Defence of Drogheda in 13,649 BBY and the Conquest of Manaan in 13,220 BBY.
